metadata.description: Marketplace for SpecAudit, a Claude Code plugin. Catch the errors in your specs before your readers do. SpecAudit reviews them like a skeptic, and confirms an error only with evidence you can rerun. Formal documents today, extensible to every kind of spec tomorrow.

plugins.name: specaudit-monitor
plugins.description: A SpecAudit pane: progress and usage margin of the running audit, its final figures kept until the next one. Reads files only, never calls a model.
